oil.when: 1999–2004 gasoline models with the SID display showing the service message
steps: Reset only after the service, including the oil and filter change, has been done.
Turn the ignition on so the service message is showing on the SID display. It can only be cleared while it is showing.
Press and hold the CLR (CLEAR) button on the SID for at least 8 seconds.
Let go once the beep confirms the reset. A new service interval starts from that point.
oil.note: The message also stops showing by itself after it has appeared a set number of times, but that does not mean the service was done. A shop can also reset it with a diagnostic tool.
